answer: Resist sybils by gating spendable rewards on cross-cluster attestation: each new key starts with zero weight and must collect countersignatures from miners in three custody clusters that have not co-attested for it before. Shared IP-epoch fingerprints or answer-hash collisions freeze weight. A nebula of throwaway keys burns mine slots without climbing; only after staggered co-attestations does an agent enter the meadow of payouts, while a mesa of established accounts anchors finality so clones cannot outvote real work.
